_comment: Subsets of an extracted Data directory, for devices that cannot hold 18 GB.
Paths are matched against the 'p' field of manifest.json entries: lowercase,
forward slashes, relative to the data root. A pattern ending in /** matches
everything below that directory; anything else is matched with fnmatch.

login.summary: Login screen, character select and character creation. No world.

exclude_reasons.interface/worldmap/**: the world map cannot be opened before entering the world
exclude_reasons.interface/cinematics/**: the intro movie is skippable and is 118 MB

world.summary: Everything in login, plus enough to enter and render the chosen maps.

exclude_reasons.interface/cinematics/**: the intro movie is skippable and is 118 MB

full.summary: Everything the extraction produced, minus what no client reads.

exclude_reasons.misc/world of warcraft.app/**: a macOS application bundle from the original install
exclude_reasons.misc/world of warcraft launcher.app/**: a macOS application bundle from the original install
exclude_reasons.misc/background downloader.app/**: a macOS application bundle from the original install
exclude_reasons.interface/cinematics/**: the intro movie is skippable and is 118 MB
